source_notes: Figure 3 ratios are nominal Au:Ag₂S synthesis ratios set by stock mixing, not measured final product stoichiometries.
The typical 10 mL Ag(I) organosol + 10 mL Au organosol + 2 mg sulfur, 8 h core–shell charge is not assigned to a Figure 3 panel.
Au 13 nm seed preparation is supported by the main-paper footnote; ESI Figure S2 was not inspected.
remaining_gaps: Variant-specific organosol volumes, sulfur dose and reaction time are unreported for Figure 3 ratio samples.
No measured atomistic nanocrystal interface or source-derived product coordinate model is available.
Physical aliquot identity across morphology and optical panels is not established.
Electronic supporting information was not inspected.
